interpretation: The observed queued unfiltered-state allocation runs for a GameInputSvc.exe child process on the investigated device. A fresh node's PID field is zero at this point. This identifies the requestor and branch; failure to initialize before publication still requires the next observation.
limitations: The zero field was read before the handler's opportunity to initialize it, so this observation alone is not proof of missing initialization.
The observed allocating process is the child PID 1668, not its SCM-reported parent PID 5708.
Debugger pauses alter timing; this is not an allocation-rate, latency or frame-time measurement.
